examples.en: Her maturity impressed everyone at the meeting.
examples.zh: 她的成熟穩重讓會議上的每個人都印象深刻。

examples.en: Most fruit trees reach maturity after about five years.
examples.zh: 大多數果樹約五年後就會進入成熟期。

examples.en: The bond reaches maturity in March next year.
examples.zh: 這張債券將在明年三月到期。

senses.zh: 可測量的；明顯的；可衡量的

examples.en: The new diet produced measurable results within a month.
examples.zh: 新的飲食法在一個月內就產生了明顯的成效。

examples.en: Teachers should set clear and measurable goals for students.
examples.zh: 老師應該為學生訂定明確且可衡量的目標。

examples.en: There is a measurable difference in temperature between the two rooms.
examples.zh: 這兩個房間的溫度有可測量的差異。

senses.zh: 機械的；機械式的；呆板的

examples.en: The clock stopped because of a mechanical problem.
examples.zh: 時鐘因為機械故障而停了。

examples.en: He works as a mechanical engineer at a car factory.
examples.zh: 他在汽車工廠擔任機械工程師。

examples.en: Her answers sounded mechanical, as if she had memorized them.
examples.zh: 她的回答聽起來很呆板，好像是背下來的。

examples.en: Our trip to Hualien was a memorable experience.
examples.zh: 我們的花蓮之旅是一次難忘的經驗。

examples.en: The teacher gave a memorable speech at the graduation.
examples.zh: 老師在畢業典禮上發表了令人難忘的演說。

examples.en: Choose a password that is both safe and memorable.
examples.zh: 請選擇一個既安全又好記的密碼。

examples.en: Many tourists visit the memorial in the center of the city.
examples.zh: 許多遊客會參觀市中心的紀念碑。

examples.en: The class planted a tree as a memorial to their old teacher.
examples.zh: 全班種了一棵樹來紀念他們的老師。

examples.en: A small memorial stands near the entrance of the park.
examples.zh: 公園入口附近立著一座小小的紀念碑。

examples.en: The school held a memorial service for the former principal.
examples.zh: 學校為前校長舉行了追思會。

examples.en: They built a memorial library in his honor.
examples.zh: 他們興建了一座紀念圖書館來向他致敬。

examples.en: A memorial concert will be held on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 週五晚上將舉行一場紀念音樂會。

examples.en: I need to memorize fifty new words before the test.
examples.zh: 我考試前要背五十個新單字。

examples.en: The actor memorized all his lines in two days.
examples.zh: 這位演員兩天就把所有台詞背了起來。

examples.en: Can you memorize the phone number while I find a pen?
examples.zh: 我去找筆的時候，你可以先記住這個電話號碼嗎？

examples.en: The merchant sold silk and tea at the market.
examples.zh: 這位商人在市場上賣絲綢和茶葉。

examples.en: Many merchants in the old street sell handmade gifts.
examples.zh: 老街上有許多商家販售手工禮品。

examples.en: A wine merchant delivered ten boxes to the restaurant.
examples.zh: 一位酒商送了十箱酒到餐廳。

examples.en: The judge showed mercy because it was his first mistake.
examples.zh: 法官因為這是他的初犯而從輕發落。

examples.en: Please have mercy on me and give me one more day.
examples.zh: 請對我寬容一點，再多給我一天。

examples.en: The lost hikers were at the mercy of the weather.
examples.zh: 迷路的登山客只能任憑天氣擺布。

examples.en: It took a mere ten minutes to finish the homework.
examples.zh: 寫完這份功課只花了短短十分鐘。

examples.en: The mere thought of the exam makes me nervous.
examples.zh: 光是想到考試就讓我緊張。

examples.en: She is a mere child, so please be patient with her.
examples.zh: 她只是個孩子，所以請對她有耐心一點。

examples.en: Each plan has its own merits and weaknesses.
examples.zh: 每個計畫都有各自的優缺點。

examples.en: She won the scholarship on merit, not by luck.
examples.zh: 她是靠實力而不是運氣拿到獎學金的。

examples.en: The committee will judge the proposal on its merits.
examples.zh: 委員會將根據提案本身的價值來評斷。

examples.en: This idea merits further discussion at the next meeting.
examples.zh: 這個想法值得在下次會議中進一步討論。

examples.en: Her hard work merits a reward from the school.
examples.zh: 她的努力值得學校給予獎勵。

examples.en: The problem merits our careful attention before we make a decision.
examples.zh: 這個問題值得我們在做決定前仔細關注。

examples.en: The messenger brought a letter to the front desk.
examples.zh: 信差把一封信送到了櫃檯。

examples.en: He works as a bicycle messenger in the city center.
examples.zh: 他在市中心擔任單車快遞員。

examples.en: She sent me a note through a messenger at school.
examples.zh: 她在學校請人幫忙傳了張紙條給我。

examples.en: My little brother's room is always messy.
examples.zh: 我弟弟的房間總是亂糟糟的。

examples.en: Eating spaghetti can be messy for young children.
examples.zh: 小朋友吃義大利麵可能會弄得一團亂。

examples.en: The business partners faced a messy dispute over their contract.
examples.zh: 這些生意合夥人因合約問題陷入棘手的爭執。

examples.en: We looked at onion cells under a microscope in biology class.
examples.zh: 我們在生物課用顯微鏡觀察洋蔥細胞。

examples.en: The lab bought a new microscope for the students.
examples.zh: 實驗室為學生買了一台新的顯微鏡。

examples.en: You can see tiny bacteria only with a powerful microscope.
examples.zh: 你只有用高倍顯微鏡才看得到微小的細菌。

examples.en: Taiwan has a mild climate in the spring.
examples.zh: 台灣的春天氣候溫和。

examples.en: He had a mild cold and stayed home for a day.
examples.zh: 他得了輕微的感冒，在家休息了一天。

examples.en: I prefer mild cheese to strong cheese.
examples.zh: 比起味道濃烈的起司，我比較喜歡口味溫和的。

examples.en: The old mill by the river is now a museum.
examples.zh: 河邊的老磨坊現在是一間博物館。

examples.en: My grandfather worked in a paper mill for thirty years.
examples.zh: 我爺爺在造紙廠工作了三十年。

examples.en: She ground the pepper with a small mill.
examples.zh: 她用一個小研磨罐磨了胡椒。

examples.en: Farmers mill the wheat into flour before selling it to bakeries.
examples.zh: 農夫把小麥磨成麵粉後，再將麵粉賣給麵包店。

examples.en: The factory mills rice for local shops.
examples.zh: 這間工廠為當地商店碾米。

examples.en: They mill the coffee beans just before brewing.
examples.zh: 他們在沖泡前才把咖啡豆磨碎。

examples.en: The miners wore helmets with lights on them.
examples.zh: 礦工戴著附有燈的安全帽。

examples.en: My great-grandfather was a coal miner who worked deep underground.
examples.zh: 我的曾祖父曾是一名在地下深處工作的煤礦工人。

examples.en: The miners came out of the tunnel after a long shift.
examples.zh: 礦工們結束長時間的輪班工作後，從坑道裡走了出來。

examples.en: Milk is a good source of minerals such as calcium.
examples.zh: 牛奶是鈣等礦物質的良好來源。

examples.en: The region is rich in minerals like copper and iron.
examples.zh: 這個地區蘊藏豐富的銅和鐵等礦物。

examples.en: We collected different minerals during the field trip.
examples.zh: 我們在校外教學時蒐集了不同的礦石。

examples.en: I always carry a bottle of mineral water.
examples.zh: 我總是隨身帶一瓶礦泉水。

examples.en: The cream contains mineral oil and vitamin E.
examples.zh: 這款乳霜含有礦物油和維他命 E。

examples.en: Mineral resources are limited on this small island.
examples.zh: 這座小島的礦產資源很有限。

examples.en: You must study a minimum of two hours every night.
examples.zh: 你每晚至少要讀兩個小時的書。

examples.en: Keep your expenses to a minimum this month.
examples.zh: 這個月請把開銷降到最低。

examples.en: The minimum for this online order is thirty dollars.
examples.zh: 這筆網路訂單的最低金額是三十元。

examples.en: The minimum age for this ride is twelve.
examples.zh: 這項遊樂設施的最低年齡限制是十二歲。

examples.en: Workers are paid at least the minimum wage.
examples.zh: 員工的薪資至少要達到最低工資。

examples.en: A minimum score of sixty is needed to pass.
examples.zh: 要及格需要最低六十分。

examples.en: The minister of education visited our school yesterday.
examples.zh: 教育部長昨天來參觀了我們學校。

examples.en: The minister answered questions from reporters about the new education policy.
examples.zh: 部長回答了記者關於新教育政策的提問。

examples.en: The minister gave a short talk at the church.
examples.zh: 牧師在教堂裡做了簡短的講道。

examples.en: Nurses minister to patients day and night.
examples.zh: 護理師日夜照顧病患。

examples.en: Volunteers ministered to the families after the typhoon.
examples.zh: 颱風過後，志工協助照顧受災的家庭。

examples.en: She ministers to the elderly at the care center.
examples.zh: 她在照護中心服務長者。

examples.en: The Ministry of Health announced a new flu program.
examples.zh: 衛生部宣布了一項新的流感計畫。

examples.en: My aunt works at the Ministry of Finance.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在財政部工作。

examples.en: He entered the ministry after finishing his studies.
examples.zh: 他完成學業後就投入了神職工作。

examples.en: The twins were full of mischief at the party.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎在派對上調皮搗蛋。

examples.en: The puppy got into mischief while we were out.
examples.zh: 我們外出時，小狗到處惹事。

examples.en: He smiled with mischief in his eyes.
examples.zh: 他眼裡帶著頑皮的神情笑了。

examples.en: I felt miserable after losing my wallet on the trip.
examples.zh: 旅途中弄丟錢包讓我覺得很難受。

examples.en: It was a cold, wet and miserable afternoon.
examples.zh: 那是個又冷又濕、令人心情低落的下午。

examples.en: They lived in miserable conditions for several months.
examples.zh: 他們在惡劣的環境中生活了好幾個月。

examples.en: He had the misfortune to miss the last train.
examples.zh: 他不幸錯過了最後一班火車。

examples.en: The family bravely faced one misfortune after another.
examples.zh: 這個家庭勇敢地面對一個接一個的不幸。

examples.en: It was our misfortune that it rained all week.
examples.zh: 很不幸，整個星期都在下雨。

examples.en: The sign was wrong and misled many drivers.
examples.zh: 這個標誌有誤，誤導了許多駕駛人。

examples.en: Do not mislead customers with false advertising.
examples.zh: 不要用不實廣告誤導顧客。

examples.en: His polite answer may mislead you about the real situation.
examples.zh: 他客氣的回答可能會讓你誤會真實的情況。

examples.en: I think you misunderstood my question about the homework deadline.
examples.zh: 我想你誤會了我關於作業截止期限的問題。

examples.en: Please do not misunderstand me; I am only trying to help.
examples.zh: 請不要誤會我，我只是想幫忙。

examples.en: Many tourists misunderstand the local custom of removing shoes indoors.
examples.zh: 許多遊客會誤解當地進屋脫鞋的習俗。

examples.en: Doctors suggest moderate exercise three times a week.
examples.zh: 醫師建議每週適度運動三次。

examples.en: The hotel offers rooms at moderate prices.
examples.zh: 這間飯店提供價格適中的房間。

examples.en: She holds moderate views on most topics.
examples.zh: 她對大多數議題都抱持溫和的看法。

examples.en: You should moderate your use of salt and sugar.
examples.zh: 你應該節制鹽和糖的攝取。

examples.en: The teacher will moderate the class discussion.
examples.zh: 老師將主持班上的討論。

examples.en: Cloud cover helps moderate the temperature at night.
examples.zh: 雲層有助於緩和夜間的氣溫。

senses.zh: 謙虛的；樸素的；幅度不大的

examples.en: He is modest about his success in the contest.
examples.zh: 他對自己在比賽中的成功很謙虛。

examples.en: They live in a modest house near the station.
examples.zh: 他們住在車站附近一間樸素的房子裡。

examples.en: The store reported a modest increase in sales.
examples.zh: 這家店的銷售額有小幅成長。

examples.en: Her modesty made everyone like her even more.
examples.zh: 她的謙虛讓大家更喜歡她。

examples.en: He accepted the prize with great modesty.
examples.zh: 他謙遜地接下了獎項。

examples.en: Modesty is an important value in many cultures.
examples.zh: 謙虛在許多文化中都是重要的價值。

examples.en: The monitor on my desk is too bright.
examples.zh: 我桌上的螢幕太亮了。

examples.en: The nurse checked the heart monitor every hour.
examples.zh: 護理師每小時檢查一次心率監測器。

examples.en: Our class monitor collects the homework each morning.
examples.zh: 我們的班長每天早上收作業。

examples.en: Scientists monitor the volcano all year round.
examples.zh: 科學家全年監測這座火山。

examples.en: Parents should monitor how long kids spend online.
examples.zh: 家長應該留意孩子上網的時間。

examples.en: The app helps you monitor your spending.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式能幫你追蹤你的花費。

examples.en: We took a photo in front of the national monument.
examples.zh: 我們在國家紀念碑前拍了照。

examples.en: The old bridge is a historic monument of the city.
examples.zh: 這座老橋是這座城市的歷史古蹟。

examples.en: A stone monument stands on the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 山頂上矗立著一座石製紀念碑。

examples.en: The room is cheap; moreover, it is close to the station.
examples.zh: 這個房間很便宜，而且離車站很近。

examples.en: He is smart. Moreover, he works very hard.
examples.zh: 他很聰明，而且工作非常努力。

examples.en: The food was delicious, and moreover, the service was excellent.
examples.zh: 食物很美味，此外服務也很棒。

senses.zh: 激勵；激發動機；使有幹勁

examples.en: A good teacher knows how to motivate students.
examples.zh: 好老師懂得如何激勵學生。

examples.en: The bonus is meant to motivate employees to work harder.
examples.zh: 這筆獎金是為了激勵員工更加努力。

examples.en: What motivated you to learn the guitar?
examples.zh: 是什麼讓你想學吉他？

examples.en: She lost her motivation to study after the long holiday.
examples.zh: 長假過後，她失去了念書的動力。

examples.en: Money is not the only motivation for working here.
examples.zh: 金錢不是在這裡工作的唯一動機。

examples.en: A kind word from the coach gave the team new motivation.
examples.zh: 教練的一句鼓勵給了球隊新的動力。

examples.en: Taiwan is a small but mountainous island.
examples.zh: 台灣是一座小而多山的島嶼。

examples.en: The train goes through a mountainous area in the east.
examples.zh: 火車穿越東部的山區。

examples.en: Traveling through mountainous areas can make some passengers feel carsick.
examples.zh: 行經山區可能會讓部分乘客暈車。

senses.zh: 泥濘的；沾滿泥巴的；混濁的

examples.en: Please take off your muddy shoes at the door.
examples.zh: 請在門口脫掉你沾滿泥巴的鞋子。

examples.en: The path was muddy after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，小路變得很泥濘。

examples.en: The river looks muddy after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，這條河看起來很混濁。

examples.en: The school offers multiple courses in art, music, and science.
examples.zh: 學校提供多門藝術、音樂和科學課程。

examples.en: He was hurt in multiple places in the accident.
examples.zh: 他在事故中多處受傷。

examples.en: The app lets you log in on multiple devices.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式讓你能在多部裝置上登入。

examples.en: Twelve is a multiple of three, but fourteen is not.
examples.zh: 十二是三的倍數，但十四不是。

examples.en: Ten is a common multiple of two and five.
examples.zh: 十是二和五的公倍數。

examples.en: Students must list every multiple of five below thirty.
examples.zh: 學生必須列出所有小於三十的五的倍數。

examples.en: The detective in the novel finally found the murderer.
examples.zh: 小說裡的偵探終於找出了兇手。

examples.en: Readers are curious about who the murderer is.
examples.zh: 讀者很好奇兇手到底是誰。

examples.en: The police are searching for the murderer in the mystery series.
examples.zh: 在這部推理劇中，警方正在追查兇手。

examples.en: A soft murmur filled the library as students discussed their projects.
examples.zh: 學生討論專題時，圖書館裡充滿輕聲細語。

examples.en: We heard the murmur of the stream behind the hotel.
examples.zh: 我們聽見飯店後方溪水的潺潺聲。

examples.en: There was a murmur of approval from the audience.
examples.zh: 觀眾發出了表示贊同的低語聲。

examples.en: She murmured a thank-you and left the room.
examples.zh: 她低聲說了謝謝就離開了房間。

examples.en: The baby murmured in her sleep while her mother watched nearby.
examples.zh: 媽媽在旁看著寶寶時，寶寶在睡夢中喃喃出聲。

examples.en: He murmured something to the waiter before leaving the restaurant.
examples.zh: 他在離開餐廳前，對服務生小聲說了些話。

examples.en: We have a mutual respect for each other.
examples.zh: 我們互相尊重。

examples.en: Tom and I met through a mutual friend.
examples.zh: 我和湯姆是透過共同的朋友認識的。

examples.en: The two companies ended the deal by mutual agreement.
examples.zh: 兩家公司經雙方同意終止了合約。

examples.en: A mysterious package arrived at our door this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上有個神秘的包裹送到我們家門口。

examples.en: The old house has a mysterious past.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子有著神秘的過去。

examples.en: She gave a mysterious smile and said nothing.
examples.zh: 她露出神秘的微笑，什麼也沒說。

examples.en: Only one student was absent, namely Tom.
examples.zh: 只有一位學生缺席，也就是湯姆。

examples.en: We need two things, namely time and money.
examples.zh: 我們需要兩樣東西，也就是時間和金錢。

examples.en: The course covers three skills, namely reading, writing and speaking.
examples.zh: 這門課涵蓋三項技能，即閱讀、寫作和口說。

examples.en: The school donated winter coats to needy families.
examples.zh: 學校捐贈冬季外套給貧困的家庭。

examples.en: Many needy students receive free lunches through the school meal program.
examples.zh: 許多清寒學生透過學校的供餐計畫獲得免費午餐。

examples.en: The charity helps needy people in our community.
examples.zh: 這個慈善團體幫助我們社區裡需要幫助的人。

senses.zh: 疏忽；忽視；疏於照料；忘了做

examples.en: Don't neglect your health when you are busy.
examples.zh: 忙碌時也別忽視自己的健康。

examples.en: He neglected to lock the door before leaving.
examples.zh: 他離開前忘了鎖門。

examples.en: The garden was neglected for years after its owner moved away.
examples.zh: 花園主人搬走後，這座花園就疏於照料了好幾年。

examples.en: The old building fell into neglect after the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉後，這棟老建築因疏於維護而逐漸荒廢。

examples.en: The accident was caused by neglect of safety rules.
examples.zh: 這起意外是因為忽視安全規定所造成的。

examples.en: Years of neglect left the park in poor condition.
examples.zh: 多年的疏於管理讓公園狀況很差。

examples.en: The two companies will negotiate a new contract next week.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司下週將協商新的合約。

examples.en: I tried to negotiate a lower price for the sofa.
examples.zh: 我試著為這張沙發談一個較低的價格。

examples.en: Workers negotiated with the manager about their hours.
examples.zh: 員工和經理協商了工作時數的問題。

examples.en: The test was hard; nevertheless, most students passed.
examples.zh: 考試很難，儘管如此，大多數學生還是及格了。

examples.en: It was raining. Nevertheless, we went to the park.
examples.zh: 當時在下雨，儘管如此我們還是去了公園。

examples.en: He was tired but nevertheless finished his report.
examples.zh: 他很累，卻還是把報告寫完了。

examples.en: I woke up from a terrible nightmare at midnight.
examples.zh: 我半夜從一場可怕的惡夢中驚醒。

examples.en: Traffic in the city center is a nightmare at five o'clock.
examples.zh: 五點的市中心交通簡直是一場惡夢。

examples.en: Moving to a new house can be a nightmare.
examples.zh: 搬到新家可能是一件很折騰的事。

examples.en: Helping others is a noble thing to do.
examples.zh: 幫助別人是一件高尚的事。

examples.en: He came from a noble family in the old country.
examples.zh: 他出身於故國的一個貴族家庭。

examples.en: The nurse has a noble spirit of service.
examples.zh: 這位護理師有著崇高的服務精神。

examples.en: The nobles lived in large castles surrounded by high stone walls.
examples.zh: 貴族們住在四周有高大石牆環繞的大城堡裡。

examples.en: Many nobles attended the royal ball to celebrate the prince's birthday.
examples.zh: 許多貴族出席了慶祝王子生日的皇家舞會。

examples.en: In the story, a noble helped the poor farmer.
examples.zh: 故事中，一位貴族幫助了貧窮的農夫。

senses.zh: 胡說；無意義的話；荒唐的事

examples.en: Don't talk nonsense; you know it isn't true.
examples.zh: 別胡說了，你知道那不是真的。

examples.en: The idea that he cheated is complete nonsense.
examples.zh: 說他作弊根本是無稽之談。

examples.en: The little girl sang a funny song full of nonsense words.
examples.zh: 小女孩唱了一首充滿無意義字詞的有趣歌曲。

examples.en: Nowadays, most students use phones to look up words.
examples.zh: 現在大多數學生都用手機查單字。

examples.en: People rarely write personal letters nowadays because email is more convenient.
examples.zh: 現今人們很少寫私人信件，因為電子郵件更方便。

examples.en: Nowadays, you can pay for almost anything with an app.
examples.zh: 如今幾乎什麼東西都能用應用程式付款。

senses.zh: 核能的；原子核的；核子的

examples.en: The museum explains how nuclear power is used to generate electricity.
examples.zh: 這間博物館說明核能如何用來發電。

examples.en: Scientists study nuclear energy in the physics lab.
examples.zh: 科學家在物理實驗室裡研究核能。

examples.en: A nuclear power plant provides electricity to many homes.
examples.zh: 核能發電廠為許多家庭供電。
